markPoints.title: Mark Points
markPoints.subtitle: Private stream highlights. !mark starts, !emark closes — times are stream uptime.
markPoints.empty: No marks yet. Type !mark in Kick chat while live, or start one here.
markPoints.modalHint: Title or note. Start and end are Kick stream uptime, not your PC clock.
markPoints.deleteBody: The saved point will be removed from your list.
markPoints.testerHint: Test mode writes locally on a test stream clock. Live Kick stays silent.
how: Owner, Kick mods, or allowlisted names type !mark or /mark to open a start at current stream uptime.
!emark or /emark closes the newest open start. Chat stays silent — no URLs or IDs.
Offline Kick chat is ignored. Studio can still record an offline mark so it is never faked as live time.
markPoints.who: Kick accepts !mark / !emark from the channel owner, moderators, editors (Kick staff badges), and Kick usernames you add below. The private review link is gated the same way — never posted in chat.
markPoints.twitchNote: Twitch can be stored as a source later. Live ingest is Kick-first.
markPoints.allowHint: Kick usernames allowed besides the owner, mods and editors.
markPoints.shareHint: Unlisted. Token plus Kick username (or your Studio login). Never send this in public chat.
markPoints.startedOffline: Saved as offline — Kick is not live.

sharedMarks.title: Mark Points
sharedMarks.gateHint: Enter your Kick username. The link alone is not enough.

customCommands.title: Custom Chat Commands
customCommands.subtitle: Create chat triggers and automatic replies for your stream.
customCommands.prefixHint: Choose how viewers fire commands: a symbol before the word (!hello), a question mark after it (hello? or سؤال؟), or the word alone.
customCommands.empty: No commands yet. Add one to start auto-replies in chat.
customCommands.name: Command
customCommands.modalHint: Viewers type the trigger in chat and the bot sends your reply.
customCommands.suffixAuto: Arabic letters use ؟ and English letters use ? automatically.
customCommands.deleteBody: The chat trigger will stop working immediately.
customCommands.testerHint: Type what a viewer would send. Matching is local and does not post to chat.
how: Pick a start symbol (! or #), an ending question mark (? ؟), or no symbol.
Add a command name and the message the bot should send.
Choose Kick, Twitch, or both, then enable the command.
customCommands.defaultSubtitle: Built-in Kick chat commands. Edit the reply — the trigger stays reserved.
customCommands.defaultHint: Customize the bot reply. The trigger name cannot be changed.
defaultHow: These five commands are always listed. Enable the ones you want in Kick chat.
Edit the reply template. The trigger (!commands, !lurk, …) cannot be renamed.
Kick sends the reply. Twitch is stored as a flag only. !clip is never taken.
customCommands.errReserved: That name is reserved for a default command.
customCommands.timerSubtitle: Repeating Kick chat messages on an interval.
customCommands.timerEmpty: No timers yet. Add one to post a repeating Kick chat message.
customCommands.timerHint: The bot posts this message on Kick every N minutes while Studio stays open.
customCommands.timerMessagePlaceholder: Follow the stream and drink water.
customCommands.timerDeleteBody: The repeating message will stop immediately.
timerHow: Write the message and how often it should post (minutes).
Enable it. The bot sends to Kick while this Studio page is open.
There is no server cron and Twitch is not sent.

schedule.title: Stream schedule
schedule.subtitle: A monthly calendar of go-live times. Share a public page or export ICS — no fake push alerts.
schedule.reminderHint: Shown on the public page (e.g. “Turn on channel notifications”). Not a push system.
schedule.reminderPlaceholder: Enable channel notifications so you don’t miss a go-live.
schedule.empty: Click a day to add a go-live. Recurring weekly slots appear on every matching weekday.
schedule.repeat: Repeat every week on this weekday
schedule.coverHint: Shown as a poster under the day’s details in the calendar. Images are compressed.
schedule.deleteBody: It will disappear from the public schedule immediately.
schedule.errCover: Could not read that image. Try a smaller JPG or PNG.
schedule.errStorage: Could not store the image locally. Try a smaller file.
schedule.how: Viewers open the public URL. They can add sessions to their own calendar via ICS. Local OS reminders come from that calendar — we do not send push notifications.

Access and refresh tokens for the platforms you connect, stored so widgets can keep reading live data.
Account basics: email address, display name and avatar.
Connected platform data you authorise: public profile (open id, username, avatar), follower and channel statistics, and channel events such as follows, subscriptions, gifts, cheers and donations.
CylixStudio is a live stream overlay tool for creators. Contact: store@creovix.com
Data is stored in an access-controlled database where every record is restricted to its owner. Tokens are only read by our servers, never exposed in the browser.
Disconnect a platform in Settings to revoke access and remove its stored tokens. To delete your whole account and all related data, email store@creovix.com and we will remove it.
Only to operate the product: render your overlays, count follower and goal progress, drive the subathon timer, and show your activity history. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
We use only essential cookies needed to keep you signed in and to secure the sign-in flow. No tracking or advertising cookies.
Widget settings and the events shown in your activity feed.

With the scopes you approve (user.info.basic, user.info.profile, user.info.stats) we read your TikTok display name, avatar, profile link and follower count. This is shown only to you inside your dashboard and in the overlays you choose to display. It is never shared with third parties.
CylixStudio provides live stream overlay widgets (subathon timer, goals, chat box, chat spotlight, emote rain and related tools) that creators embed into their broadcasting software.
Do not use the service to break the rules of any streaming platform, to harass others, to distribute unlawful content, or to attempt to access other users' data.
Some features require an activation code. Codes begin their validity when redeemed and may be revoked if obtained or used improperly.
The service is provided “as is”. We work to keep it online but cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability, and we are not liable for lost stream revenue or other indirect damages.

When you connect a platform you authorise CylixStudio to read the channel data you approved (profile details, follower statistics and channel events) so the widgets can display live information. You can disconnect any platform at any time from Settings, and we stop reading its data immediately.
You may stop using the service and delete your connections at any time. We may suspend accounts that breach these terms.
You sign in with a streaming account (Twitch, Kick, TikTok and similar). You are responsible for activity on your account and for keeping your access tokens private.
